hypothesis.statement: At least one preregistered deterministic coordinate predicate family, composed with the frozen lexicographically least degree-two representative compiler, preserves nonvacuous valid structured-embedding support across generated 5-8 bit curves and improves the exact retained-support frontier at one fixed matched constrained-label cap over four hash-ranked x-fiber controls.
hypothesis.mechanism: Coordinate order may correlate EC evaluations of forced degree-two and balanced degree-four formal multisets. Conditional on the frozen representative compiler, this correlation could reduce semantic closure conflicts without suppressing the final 4F+4F sumset, allowing an injective order ideal to retain more final support under the same absolute constrained-label cap than a symmetry-matched hash-ranked x-fiber set.
assumptions: MODEL-BOUND: a valid partial operation is evidence inside the structured generic-group formalism, not a lower bound or an algorithm for conventional curve coordinates.
TOY-EVIDENCE: q has only 5-8 bits and cannot establish a cryptographic exponent.
HEURISTIC: the deterministic curve generator and three predicate families are probes of persistence, not a representative measure over all curves or coordinate predicates.
COMPILER-BOUND: the tested construction uses the lexicographically least formal witness for every nonidentity 2F output; no factor-base-invariant claim is allowed.

EXACT-MATRIX: all 168 rows and all 672 cap cells must have an independently proved exact primary optimum and a deterministic replay-confirmed complete five-field objective; a structurally separate complete five-field oracle exists only for frozen B4, and one unresolved cell makes the family matrix invalid and the hypothesis outcome inconclusive.
NOVELTY-UNVERIFIED: no claim of a new theorem or attack is authorized without broader literature and independent review.

predictions.minimum_effect: one fixed coordinate family has an exact median ratio at least 1/4 in every 5-8 bit stratum

predictions.metric: exact retained support at a fixed matched constrained-label cap versus four hash-x controls
predictions.minimum_effect: for the same fixed family and either the 1/2 or 3/4 cap across all strata, at least three bit strata have nonnegative median threshold margin after subtracting max(1,ceil(q/20)), and at least 18 of 24 curve-B comparisons have positive coordinate-minus-null-median support

all 672 cap cells have zero primary gap, an empty live frontier, an independently proved primary optimum, and a replay-confirmed complete secondary objective; frozen B4 additionally matches the structurally separate complete five-field oracle

predictions.metric: structured embedding validity and source interface
predictions.minimum_effect: all interpreted rows pass every exact axiom, expose a complete public label-to-formal source table, and expose zero direct final-layer edges

instances: two deterministically generated and independently rederived accepted curves for each q bit size in {5,6,7,8}
the frozen EXP-SGCP-EMBED-001 p=19,a=2,b=9,q=23 fixture as an implementation regression only

budget.verifier_input_ceilings: one final-component no-follow, nonblocking regular-file snapshot with initial st_size at most 256 MiB before allocation or reading; parent-component symlinks disclosed and allowed; path-based verify_document is the sole evidence-bearing API; each public call creates invocation-local work, reservation, and cache state, binds it to the creating thread, closes it before context restoration, and rejects direct path-worker re-entry; semantic internals require its active process-local permit and worker token; one exact-size bytearray is filled and hashed, file identity and length are rechecked, and an ASCII lexical preflight rejects insignificant whitespace, more than 2000000 tokens, depth above 64, raw strings above 8 MiB, and scalar tokens above 1024 bytes before object construction; the same buffer is strictly decoded and cleared before JSON parsing; reflected input-path metadata is limited to 4096 ASCII bytes or replaced by a bounded omission marker; source-sized collection bounds precede the generic 2000000-node, depth-64, 8-MiB-string object walk; diagnostics are limited to 256 items and 65536 bytes; the complete serialized report is limited to 8 MiB; exact registered B in {4,6,8}, frozen/canonical row associations, source-owned replay caps, and exact primary-node budget in 0..5000000 are required
budget.verifier_work_reservation: inside one invocation-local state and only through exact positive-integer charges, reserve before row semantics separate worst-case totals for registered prime candidates, curve draws and hashes, predicate hashes, frozen, semantic, and primary point enumerations, expansion cells, graph candidate evaluations, eligible conflict checks, eligible pair-output cells, replay nodes, primary nodes, both replay caches, both primary caches, retained-model calls, and retained-model cells; charge graph and expansion work inside the executed loops and charge nodes and cache entries as they execute or are inserted; preserve the reservation and partial lower-bound work on exceptions, including predicate reconstruction; on a completed row require exact reconstructed deltas for graph candidates, eligible conflicts, eligible-squared pair outputs, and degree 1, 2, 4, and 8 expansion multisets; after every row passes semantic curve and factor-base reconstruction, derive and equality-check the five deterministic provenance/predicate counters from the verified transcripts; require actual work to be complete, every successful unit phase to be closed, and all counters to be dominated by the source-owned reservation as validity invariants; any mismatch, over-limit reservation, or observed overage is invalid and INCONCLUSIVE
budget.verifier_output_boundary: the finite pre-normalization input domain is exact str, pathlib.Path, or os.PathLike yielding exact str; verifier and producer CLI parsers retain --output as a Python-decoded exact str, verifier main applies output admission before input verification, and the writer receives that same raw string; reject bytes and byte-valued path-like objects, string subclasses, unsupported or null objects, empty strings, embedded NUL, relative strings, terminal slash, terminal dot components, explicit parent traversal, and the exact POSIX double-separator anchor before Path construction or absolute normalization; normalize internal dot and repeated separators, and on the controlled POSIX runtime normalize any three-or-more leading separator run to the ordinary root anchor before requiring a nonroot destination below the development root; arbitrary caller __fspath__ code executes before its return value can be classified, so caller-created effects are outside the verifier no-destination guarantee, which begins after os.fspath returns and covers verifier-created effects for inert inputs; the descriptor walker invokes the same raw grammar and independently repeats normalized root containment before opening root-relative parents no-follow; before writing, both the no-overwrite data name and deterministic receipt name must be absent; the canonical receipt binds a random 256-bit publication identifier, destination basename, development-root-relative path, payload bytes and SHA-256, protocol, experiment, and its own digest; after receipt publication begins, an ordinary synchronous exception returns accepted only when a fresh terminal validation matches that exact identifier and payload, with a structured reconciliation warning; observed direct-write inode type or size mismatch is fatal, while unavailable durability metadata may be warned only if final validation succeeds; raw argv bytes before Python decoding, shell and OS decoding, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit, process termination, memory exhaustion, and hostile same-user mutation remain outside the guarantee

falsification_conditions: After one complete valid exact matrix, no single coordinate-family and cap-fraction pair meets both the full-cap persistence and matched-null advantage predictions.
The exact median retained-to-balanced-raw support ratio of every coordinate family is below 1/10 in at least three bit strata.
interpretation_limits: Failure rejects or weakens only these generated curves, fixed B values, predicates, the frozen representative compiler, and the balanced degree-four order-ideal construction.
Success would be a toy coordinate-structure signal and a reason to test a larger compiler family; it would not be an index-calculus relation generator.
No fitted exponent is allowed from four tiny bit sizes.
The public source table is explicit fixed-row advice and its serialized bytes are charged; it is not a free inversion oracle.
The experiment does not measure relation rank, factor-base logarithms, individual descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, memory bandwidth, verifier cost, or rho cost.
Structural-work counters are deterministic combinatorial cell counts, not CPU instructions, field-operation totals, or peak-memory measurements.

The transient frozen B4, B6, and B8 legacy semantic rows are noncanonical predecessor controls; they are not generated curve-family density rows, and only the separate frozen B4 density document is evidence-bearing implementation control.
V18 preserves 17 historical V1 development rows and one historical development run manifest; it creates and authorizes zero generated V18 curve-family density rows and zero canonical runs.

A failed axiom, provenance mismatch, optimizer disagreement, mismatched control, malformed exact type, scalar-material leak, resource exhaustion, or incomplete matrix invalidates the evidence and yields INCONCLUSIVE; none is mathematical falsification.

A malformed, out-of-range, V1-V17 legacy-schema, changing, nonregular, unregistered, lexically amplified, or over-ceiling verifier input must return an invalid V18 path-based receipt and is INCONCLUSIVE; it is not a hypothesis outcome.

A publication data path without a complete matching V18 completion receipt is unaccepted. A matching attempt-bound receipt is a logical content commit, not authentication against a hostile same-user actor or proof that every durability syscall succeeded; future runners must preserve the structured warning vector and external artifact-store receipt.
The verifier source SHA-256 is a diagnostic module-load snapshot, not executed-code attestation; only a future immutable runner may bind the executed commit and command.
The SGGM hard distribution and class-wide tightness result do not imply that a high-density coordinate embedding yields an attack on conventional encodings.
